meta.name: mass-ulw
meta.description: Drives dependency-ordered child work through the native workflow tool, one run per phase with retry/amend/send recovery. Use when the user asks for mass-ulw, a DAG of tasks, or fan-out work where some tasks must wait on others.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按依赖顺序分阶段推进多步骤任务,出错可重试或修改后继续。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常需要让多个互有先后依赖的任务按序自动推进。
copy.tagline_en: Run dependent subtasks in phases, with retry and repair on failure.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to push groups of ordered tasks automatically.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把有依赖的多步任务拆成节点，用工作流工具按依赖顺序执行并产出结果；某节点失败可单独重试、改指令或发消息，已完成节点不重跑。
howto.when: 当你说出「mass-ulw」、布置任务 DAG，或要求做“部分任务须等其它任务完成”的并行工作时，该技能会接管；若任务彼此独立则不触发。

say.text: 请用 mass-ulw 把这几个有依赖关系的任务按顺序跑完。
say.note: 按依赖关系分批执行这些任务。

say.text: 布置一个 DAG 任务：先做 A，等 A 完成后再并行做 B 和 C。
say.note: A 完成后才会启动 B 和 C。

say.text: 这些子任务部分要等前置完成，帮我用扇出方式并行处理。
say.note: 先执行无依赖节点，再执行后续节点。

howto.what_en: Claude turns dependent multi-step work into nodes, executes them in order with the workflow tool, then returns the result. A failed node can be retried, amended or sent a message; completed nodes are reused.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention mass-ulw, ask for a task DAG, or request fan-out work where some tasks must wait on earlier ones. Independent tasks don't trigger it.

say_en.text: Use mass-ulw to run these dependent tasks in order.
Set up a DAG: first do A, then run B and C in parallel after A.
say_en.note: B and C start only after A is done.

say_en.text: Some subtasks require earlier ones; run them as fan-out work.
say_en.note: Independent nodes run first, then downstream stages.
